I have enough context. No DB schema change needed (gold/hp already columns). Here's the full file-by-file plan.

## Worker (backend)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`worker/src/types/index.ts`** | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string; }` interface (mirrors `ShopTransactionBody`). Optionally add a per-night cost constant, e.g. `export const INN_REST_COST = 10;`. |
| **`worker/src/routes/shop.ts`** (or a new `worker/src/routes/inn.ts`) | Add `POST /api/shop/rest` (or new `innRoutes` mounted at `/api/inn`). Handler: load character via `getCharacter`, compute cost (flat or `level * X`), return `400` if `character.gold < cost`, else `db.batch([... deduct gold, set hp = max_hp ...])` (same pattern as the buy/sell batch in `shopRoutes.post('/transaction')`), then return `{ success, cost, updatedGold, updatedHp }`. |
| **`worker/src/services/character.ts`** | No new function strictly required — `updateCharacter` already accepts `gold`/`hp` partial updates — but could add a small `restAtInn(db, character)` helper to keep the route thin, following the style of `levelUp()`. |
| **`worker/src/index.ts`** | If a new route file is created, import and `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes)`; if reusing `shop.ts`, no change needed here. |
| **`worker/src/db/seed.sql`** | No change required (gold cost can be a constant), unless you want per-inn pricing — then add a `cost_per_night` column/row to `shops`. |

## Frontend (Angular)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** | Add `restAtInn(sessionId: string, characterId: string): Observable<{ success: boolean; cost: number; updatedGold: number; updatedHp: number }>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/shop/rest` (or `/api/inn/rest`), mirroring `shopTransaction()`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`** | No new state fields needed — reuse `setCharacter()` to push the updated `hp`/`gold` after the call. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/character-sheet/character-sheet.component.ts`** | Inject `GameApiService`; add `restAtInn()` method that calls the service and updates `CharacterStateService` on success (e.g., disable if `c.gold < cost`). |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/character-sheet/character-sheet.component.html`** | Add a "🛏️ Rest at Inn (Xg)" button near the HP/Gold stats, disabled when `c.hp === c.max_hp` or `c.gold < cost`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/character-sheet/character-sheet.component.css`** | Minor styling for the new button. |
| **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** | No new types strictly required (reuses `Character`), unless you want a typed rest-response interface. |

No D1 migration is required since `characters.gold` and `characters.hp`/`max_hp` already exist; the whole feature is additive (one new route + one new button), following the existing buy/sell pattern in `shop.ts`.
